main.description: The latest published head (root pointer) for a graph, from the authoritative Durable Object (mirrored to KV for fast reads). Empty root means no member has published yet; the client falls back to the static genesis pointer. The browser then hydrates the Datom log by fetching the covering Prolly-tree blocks (CID-verified) — no kotoba query node is exposed.

root.description: CIDv1 multibase of the current head, or empty if none.

blocks.description: Block CIDs included in the most recent publish (a hint; clients should traverse via missingBlockCids).

did.description: did:key of the most recent publisher.
